items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I remember Baby Dodge used to call it a drum tag.

ctx.x: No, I used to remember the guys saying, I used to go to St. Alex and Adam, after finishing the number, people would be applauding for it to play the tune over again. God said, watch them, let's fool. And they start right back on it. This drum would start off and then they start playing that number again.
I remember Baby Dodge used to call it a drum tag. He'd call it a tag that they put on.
That's the only thing I used to remember the guys saying, let's fool them. That song is starting right back over again.
